483.h: Southern Atlantic University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
483.c: It is located in Uyo, the capital of Akwa Ibom State.

484.h: Lens University is a private university licensed by the National Universities Commission in 2025. It was one of eleven private universities approved by President Bola Tinubu on 3 March 2025.
484.c: It is located in Ilemona, in Oyun local government area of Kwara State.

485.h: Monarch University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
485.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes. Its leadership includes Professor Omoegun, a former Dean of Education at the University of Lagos and pioneer Dean of Education at Ajayi Crowther University.
485.c: It is located in Iyesi-Ota, Ogun State.

486.h: Tonine Iredia University of Communication is a private university named after Tonnie Iredia, the broadcaster and former director-general of the Nigerian Television Authority. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
486.a: As its name indicates, the university specialises in communication and media studies.
486.c: It is located in Benin City, Edo State.

487.h: Isaac Balami University of Aeronautics and Management (IBUAM) is a private university founded by Engineer Isaac Balami, an aviation engineer. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
487.a: The university specialises in aviation education, research and management.
487.c: It is located in Lagos State.

488.h: Kevin Eze University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
488.a: The university offers science programmes such as computer science and biochemistry.
488.c: It is located in Mgbowo, Enugu State.

489.h: Tazkiyah University, Kaduna is a private university and Nigeria's first fully approved all-female university. It was founded by Professor Ibrahim Ahmad Maqari, Chief Imam of the National Mosque, Abuja. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
489.a: The university admits women only and offers undergraduate programmes.
489.c: It is located in Kaduna, Kaduna State.

490.h: Leadership University, Abuja is a private university founded by a group of individuals and faith-based organisations. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
490.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes with an emphasis on leadership.
490.c: It is located in Abuja, the Federal Capital Territory.

491.h: Jimoh Babalola University is a private university founded by Jimoh Babalola. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
491.c: It is located in Kwara State.

492.h: Bridget University Mbaise is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
492.c: It is located at Okirika-Nweke, in the Mbaise area of Imo State.

493.h: Greenland University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
493.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and runs a football academy that combines player development with education.
493.c: It is located in Jalingo, Taraba State.

494.h: JEFAP University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
494.c: It is located in Suleja, Niger State, close to Abuja.

495.h: Azione Verde University is a private university that received Federal Government approval as one of nine new private universities. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
495.c: It is located in Amaigbo, Imo State.

496.h: Unique Open University is a private open university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025. It was created to widen access to university education for people who cannot attend a conventional campus.
496.a: Programmes are delivered by open and distance learning.
496.c: It is based in Ojo, Lagos State.

497.h: American Open University is a private open university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2025.
497.a: The university admits all qualified applicants, including those with learning disabilities, and delivers programmes online with some campus residencies, including professional master's degrees for working people.
497.c: It is based in Abeokuta, Ogun State.

498.h: Abdulkadir Kure University is a public university owned by the Niger State Government and named after Abdulkadir Kure, governor of Niger State from 1999 to 2007. It was established in 2023, originally as a university of education, and has since become a conventional university.
498.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes across several fields.
498.c: It is located in Minna, the capital of Niger State.

499.h: Abiola Ajimobi Technical University, formerly First Technical University, Ibadan, is a public university owned by the Oyo State Government and the first technical university in Nigeria. It was approved by the National Universities Commission in 2012. Governor Seyi Makinde renamed it in honour of his predecessor, Abiola Ajimobi.
499.a: As a technical university, it focuses on engineering, technology and applied sciences.
499.c: It is located in Ibadan, Oyo State.

500.h: Aliko Dangote University of Science and Technology, formerly Kano University of Science and Technology, is a public university owned by the Kano State Government. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2000, and teaching began in 2001.
500.a: The university focuses on science and technology programmes and is a member of the Association of Commonwealth Universities.
500.c: It is located in Wudil, Kano State.

501.h: Bayelsa Medical University (BMU) is a public university specialising in medicine and the health sciences, established in 2019 by Seriake Dickson, then governor of Bayelsa State.
501.a: The university trains doctors and other health professionals.
501.c: It is located in Yenagoa, the capital of Bayelsa State.

502.h: Dennis Osadebay University, Asaba is a public university, one of three new universities set up by the Delta State Government and approved by the National Universities Commission in 2021. It is named after Dennis Osadebay, premier of the former Mid-Western Region.
502.a: The university offers undergraduate courses in six faculties, including agriculture, science, and management and social sciences.
502.c: It is located in Asaba, the capital of Delta State.

503.h: Emmanuel Alayande University of Education is a public university of education owned by the Oyo State Government. It developed from the Emmanuel Alayande College of Education, and the National Universities Commission records its establishment as a university in 2022.
503.a: The university specialises in training teachers.
503.c: It is located in Oyo town, Oyo State.

504.h: Kingsley Ozumba Mbadiwe University (KOMU), formerly Eastern Palm University, is a public university owned by the Imo State Government. It is named after Kingsley Ozumba Mbadiwe, the nationalist politician. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2016.
504.a: The university was created to meet demand for higher education and offers undergraduate programmes.
504.c: It is located at Ogboko, in Ideato South local government area of Imo State.

505.h: Prince Abubakar Audu University (PAAU), formerly Kogi State University, is a public university owned by the Kogi State Government. It was established in 1999 under Governor Abubakar Audu, and in 2020 Governor Yahaya Bello renamed it in his honour. Its pioneer vice-chancellor was Professor S. K. Okwute, a chemist, who served from 2000 to 2005.
505.a: The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, including medicine.
505.c: It is located in Anyigba, Kogi State.

506.h: Olusegun Agagu University of Science and Technology (OAUSTECH), formerly Ondo State University of Science and Technology, is a public university owned by the Ondo State Government. It was established in 2008 under Governor Olusegun Agagu, after whom it is now named, and teaching began in January 2011.
506.a: The university focuses on science and technology programmes.
506.c: It is located in Okitipupa, Ondo State.

507.h: Rivers State University (RSU), formerly Rivers State University of Science and Technology, is a public university owned by the Rivers State Government. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 1979.
507.a: RSU offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in engineering, sciences, medicine, law, management and other fields.
507.c: The main campus is in the Mile III area of Diobu, Port Harcourt.

508.h: The University of Cross River State (UNICROSS), formerly Cross River University of Technology (CRUTECH), is a public university owned by the Cross River State Government. It was created in 2002 by Governor Donald Duke by merging three existing state institutions. The National Universities Commission records 2004.
508.a: The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
508.c: It has four campuses in four local government areas of Cross River State, with its main base in Calabar.

509.h: The University of Delta (UNIDEL) is a public university owned by the Delta State Government. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021.
509.a: The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses in faculties including agriculture, arts, education, information technology, science, engineering, medicine and law.
509.c: It has three campuses: Agbor (Alihame), Owa-Oyibu and Owa-Alero, in Delta State.
